summary.text: Robin Weisz is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 14 (Hurdsfield), serving since 1997 and as Speaker of the House. The page lists him as a member of the Budget Section and Legislative Management in the interim.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Weisz is a farmer and businessman who attended UND.
His biography lists service as chairman of Lynn Township, a 1999 BILLD Fellowship, a 2006 Henry Toll Fellowship, and Legislator of the Year awards from NDEMSA, NDTOA and MHA.
He serves on the interim Budget Section and Legislative Management and is vice chair of the procedural Committees committee.
His biography lists him as married to Lori, with two children.
